01 — THE SPARK

Thoughtful design.
Within reach.

Good design. Without the premium price.

The bike computers I found felt like a compromise: affordable but clunky, or expensive yet still stuck with dated, rigid interfaces.

PedalOne started with a simple idea: clear screens, phone-free riding, and thoughtful design—at a price more riders could reach.

02 — YOUR NEW CO-PILOT

Everything you need.
Nothing holding you back.

Your route. Your ride data. Right on your handlebars.
Powered by open-source PedalOS.

A LITTLE SCREEN. A LOT OF RIDE.

01 / NAVIGATE

Less guessing.
More going.

Turn-by-turn directions and a full-color map keep the next turn in view. Take the scenic route with a little more confidence.

⌖
Your GPS. Not your phone’s.

Built-in GPS lets the computer handle the ride. No phone required on the handlebars.

FOCUS ON THE ROAD

Ride data, at a glance.

Speed, distance, ride time, and navigation. The essentials, in a dedicated display built around cycling.

KEEP YOUR OPTIONS OPEN

Your ride. Your setup.

Use the computer on its own for your ride, with an iOS companion app for the connected experience.

LESS BARRIER TO ENTRY

Completely open. Your way in.

Completely open-source software based on PedalOS, with build-your-own, partial-kit, or fully assembled hardware options. You shouldn’t need a premium budget—or electronics skills—to join the ride.
